SCHEDULE
(Section 4)
1. Residence.
Furnished residence with staff shall be provided and
maintained by the Government.
2. Transport and Travelling.

Two motor-cars shall be provided and maintained by the
Government and all travelling expenses paid by the Govern-
ment.

3. Medical Facilities.

Medical attention and hospital treatment shall be provided
by the Government.

Passed in the Legislative Council on the first day of
May, 1958.

C. A. FREDERICKS,
Clerk of the Legislative Council
